about: Regression reference for scripts/check-typography-reference.mjs. With every text area at Standard (Manrope) and 100 %, each visible text element, icon and app mark must match the reference commit. Every difference must be covered by one exception below, with its reason; an uncovered difference or an exception that no longer matches anything fails the check.

reference.why: Last commit before the typography settings (single Home font, no date). Its app/ files are served directly from Git objects; nothing is exported or checked out.

exceptions.reason: New feature: the local date (dd.mm.yyyy) below the time on Home and in the Home preview beside Settings. Only its addition is allowed; the time itself must keep its reference position, size and font.

The Settings overview group 'Schrift' with the single font name became 'Schriften' with a summary of the four areas; at Standard the summary reads 'Standard'. Position and font of the row are unchanged.
